note: Each text is what he asks the tutor; a Greek word is in braces, as Lampas shows it in that chapter. The clip says the braced word in Lampas's modern respelling (sttbakeoff/clips.py speakable).

questions.text: What does {τεκνία} mean in verse one?
Why does John call Jesus our {παράκλητον} here?
Is {ἱλασμός} the same thing as atonement?
What tense is {γινώσκομεν} in verse three?
How is {ψεύστης} different from {ψεῦδος}?
Does {τετελείωται} mean the love is finished or made complete?
Why is the commandment {καινὴν} and {παλαιάν} at the same time?
What is the difference between {σκοτία} and {φῶς} in verse eight?
Can you explain {σκάνδαλον} in verse ten?
Who are the {νεανίσκοι} and how have they {νενικήκατε} the evil one?
Does {ἀλαζονεία} {τοῦ} {βίου} mean pride in possessions?
How is {ἀντίχριστος} used with {ἐσχάτη} {ὥρα} in this verse?
What is the {χρίσμα} that John says we have?
Why does Paul say there is no {κατάκριμα} for those in Christ?
What does {σάρκα} mean in verse four?
Is {πνεῦμα} here the Holy Spirit or the human spirit?
Why is the {φρόνημα} of the flesh {θάνατος}?
What does {υἱοθεσίας} mean in verse fifteen?
Why does Paul put {ἀββᾶ} next to {πατήρ}?
Can you explain {ἀποκαραδοκία} in verse nineteen?
What is the {ματαιότητι} that creation was subjected to?
Why does creation {συστενάζει} and {συνωδίνει} together?
What does {στεναγμοῖς} {ἀλαλήτοις} mean?
